panels.title: İstek Hızı (req/s)
panels.description: Seçili servis/route için toplam saniyedeki istek sayısı.

panels.title: 5xx Oranı
panels.description: 5xx istek / toplam istek. İstek yoksa NaN (veri yok) görünür.

panels.title: Apdex (T=0.25s)
panels.description: (memnun + tolere/2) / toplam. Memnun: ≤0.25s, tolere: ≤1s (4T yerine histogram bucket'ı 1.0).

panels.title: Çalışan Servis Örneği
panels.description: Son 5 dk içinde veri gönderen örnekler (yeniden başlatma sonrası eski seriler dahil olabilir).

targets.expr: (sum by (service_name)(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$rate])) or 0 * sum by (service_name)(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", http_route=~"$route"}[$rate]))) / sum by (service_name)(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", http_route=~"$route"}[$rate]))

sum by (service_name)(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_sum{service_name=~"$service", http_route=~"$route"}[$rate])) / sum by (service_name)(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", http_route=~"$route"}[$rate]))

panels.title: p50 / p95 / p99 Gecikme (birleşik)
panels.description: Bucket sınırı 10s'dir; değerler bucket içinde lineer interpolasyonla tahmin edilir.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, http_route)(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service", http_route=~"$route"}[$rate]))))
